description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream's Grip without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Dream's Grip, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Dream's Grips, untapping Isochron Scepter and Lotus Field.
Repeat.
